common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

common.title: Frontier Access Denied
common.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

common.title: Evaluation Anomalies Escalate
common.line: Benchmark results from an unreleased system leak, or an evaluation team reports behaviour it cannot explain – capability appearing where it was not trained, an eval saturating far earlier than projected, or a model handling the fact of being evaluated in a way nobody designed for.

common.title: Knowledge Work Is Boosted, Not Replaced
common.line: The evidence arrives from ordinary offices rather than from laboratories: measured productivity gains in law, accountancy, administration, journalism and consulting, largest among the least experienced, and no matching fall in employment.

notable.title: Local connection freeze
notable.line: A coordinated winter protest wave forces several municipalities to pause new data centre grid connections pending local referendums, freezing permitted sites regardless of funding.

notable.title: Siting revolt
notable.line: Coordinated municipal refusals block grid connections for the five zoned gigafactory sites and force formal permit lapse after anti-data-centre marches merge with health-record anger.
